verdict.rationale: Forter documents an official MCP server that lets an AI system take real actions, including reviewing decisions, managing disputes, and "updating policies" via natural language, and it can be connected to Claude Desktop. This covers the core idea of agent-driven policy management. Nothing in the evidence specifically covers rule or list operations, read access to posture, or approval gates. Missing for 10: explicit velocity-rule creation, blocklist/allowlist management, read-only fraud posture access, human approval gates for agent-proposed changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
